title: HOW HEALING STAYS
hookText: How to Keep Your Healing for Good
openLoop: Why healing received isn't always healing kept

recap.title: How to keep living in health
items: Walk it out daily — faith continues
Don't switch back to fear or drugs

scenes.point: Don't say 'I am sick' — say 'I am strong'
scenes.teaser: Why your words decide your health

scenes.point: Saying 'I am strong' is declaring faith in His name
scenes.teaser: But receiving it isn't the whole story

scenes.point: Faith is what receives your healing from God
scenes.teaser: One switch makes people lose it

scenes.point: Don't trust God once, then trust drugs and fear later
Healing is like a bicycle — keep pedaling, keep trusting
scenes.teaser: The secret is where you look

scenes.point: Like a ship to the lighthouse — keep your eyes on Jesus
